methodology: Latest review samples are refreshed and previously collected dated comments retained; the history view adds deduplicated recent and helpful App Store samples and dated Google Play observations.
Apple ID storefront; Google ID country / Indonesian language request. Reviewer residence is not verified.
Positive = 4–5 stars, neutral = 3, negative = 1–2. This is a rating proxy, not validated text sentiment.
Topics use explicit keyword rules; ambiguous multi-service feedback is left unassigned.
Store aggregate ratings have different definitions and populations. Samples are self-selected and are not NPS, churn or market share.
Allegations in review excerpts are unverified; confirm with service incident / complaint data.
Play review timestamps arrive without a timezone offset; the returned calendar date is retained.
